description: One sentence in Turkish or English (2 to 200 characters), read as filters and niche words; the best candidates are then scored for relevance (detailed mode, about 30 seconds). Returns the count and up to two strong matches as open cards, each with the niches that matched (cards are ordered by relevance, then measured engagement, then followers; no score is returned); sometimes one or none. The ranking field tells how they were chosen. An optional safety object (flagged true, reason filtered or sensitive_condition) says details were withheld for privacy or safety; it never repeats the words.
name: ai_search_influencers
title: AI search for influencers
